product_family: AI-native low-code platform for building internal enterprise apps, AI agents, and workflows. Available as ToolJet Cloud (hosted SaaS), self-hosted / on-premise deployment (Docker, Kubernetes, air-gapped), and an open-source core (ToolJet on GitHub) that underlies the commercial "ToolJet AI" enterprise offering.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Compliances: ISO 27001 v2022 - Compliant; ISO 27001 - Compliant

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a HIPAA certification or signed BAA program. HIPAA is not mentioned anywhere in ToolJet's own compliance documentation (docs.tooljet.com/docs/security/compliance/ lists only SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and ISO 27001; HIPAA is absent, not affirmatively disclaimed). One third-party summary mentions SSO 'with HIPAA support' but this refers to identity/access controls, not a HIPAA attestation or BAA offering.

privacy.ai_training_note: Privacy policy states: 'We do not use any customer data - whether personal, behavioral, or usage-related - to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve our AI models or underlying technology.' The enterprise-security page separately advertises 'DPA and data residency commitments' as part of its enterprise trust features, indicating a DPA is offered (likely to paid/enterprise customers on request rather than universally self-serve).
privacy.data_region: No fixed region guarantee for the standard offering: privacy policy states 'ToolJet may transfer and/or store Information it collects in any country.' Self-hosted/on-premise and enterprise deployments let customers pin data to their own infrastructure/region (AWS, Azure, GCP, or air-gapped), per the enterprise-security and home pages.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS 1.2+/1.3, HSTS and modern ciphers ('TLS everywhere')

security.name: SSO / Identity
security.value: SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, OAuth2, LDAP; supports Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace, Auth0, Ping, Keycloak; SSO-only enforcement and MFA via IdP; SCIM/group sync

security.name: Access control
security.value: RBAC with app-level and page-level granular permissions; scoped access for datasources and secrets

security.name: Audit logging
security.value: Audit log retention windows with export to SIEM

security.name: Deployment isolation options
security.value: Self-hosted / on-premise / air-gapped deployment options in addition to ToolJet Cloud; customer controls where infrastructure and data live

products.name: ToolJet Cloud
products.data_scope: Customer app data, connected datasource credentials, and end-user data hosted on ToolJet's cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP per enterprise page); subject to trust center compliance posture (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR).
products.notes: Default offering for most customers; data residency not fixed by default per privacy policy.

products.name: Self-hosted / On-premise ToolJet
products.data_scope: All application and end-user data stays entirely within the customer's own infrastructure; ToolJet has no access.
products.notes: Marketed explicitly for compliance-sensitive buyers ('meet compliance requirements without compromising on speed... your data stays where your IT team wants it').

products.name: Open-source ToolJet (core)
products.data_scope: Fully self-hosted by the user; no vendor data handling at all.
products.notes: Foundation of the commercial ToolJet AI enterprise product; 38k+ GitHub stars per home page.

products.name: ToolJet AI Agents / Workflows
products.category: AI-powered automation layer (agents, natural-language app generation)
products.data_scope: May process prompts and connected data through AI/LLM integrations to generate apps, dashboards, and workflow logic.
products.notes: Vendor states customer data is not used to train or fine-tune its AI models (see privacy policy); scope of any third-party LLM sub-processing was not independently documented on the pages captured.

compare.pricing_model: Tiered SaaS pricing (self-serve) plus enterprise/self-hosted contracts; also offers guided 'forward deployed engineer' delivery for enterprise buyers
compare.data_residency: Flexible: default cloud offering has no fixed region guarantee (privacy policy allows storage 'in any country'); self-hosted/on-premise/air-gapped deployment lets customers fully control region and infrastructure

flags: Trust center (trust.tooljet.com) returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches, so live cross-verification of exact SOC 2 type (I vs II) and current cert dates could not be done directly against that page in this session; SOC 2 Type II language was corroborated via ToolJet's own docs.tooljet.com compliance page and enterprise-security page, but no downloadable SOC 2 report or audit date/period was found on a public vendor page.
Trust center lists 'ISO 27001 v2022 - Compliant' and a separate duplicate line 'ISO 27001 - Compliant' with no distinguishing detail; likely a rendering artifact of the trust-center widget (e.g.

Two vendor domains in use (tooljet.com and tooljet.ai) for marketing vs. legal/privacy pages; content is consistent and both clearly refer to the same company and product, but the split is worth noting for anyone auditing the vendor's web presence.

No HIPAA BAA or attestation found on any vendor-owned page; a third-party-derived summary referenced 'HIPAA support' in the context of SSO, which is not equivalent to a HIPAA compliance program and should not be represented as one.
